what_they_do: Olympian builds AI voice and text agents that answer phone calls, texts, and web inquiries for home remodeling contractors (roofing, siding, windows, doors, fencing, decking, flooring, landscaping, painting, exterior/interior remodeling). The agents qualify leads, book appointments onto the contractor's schedule, and follow up with leads who don't convert on the first contact. This replaces the job a human receptionist or office admin does today: picking up the phone, asking qualifying questions, and manually chasing leads who don't answer a call-back, which the company says causes remodelers to miss roughly 15% of inbound inquiries.
theme_fit_rationale: Olympian's product lives inside the actual conversations (inbound/outbound calls, texts, web chats) between remodeling contractors and homeowners, which is exactly the high-frequency, high-stakes conversational surface Theme 8 describes, and 'home services and contractors' is one of Theme 8's named use cases verbatim. The expansion path matches the thesis too: starting as a receptionist/scheduler and expanding into sales coordination and marketing outreach means Olympian is positioned to become the system of record for the contractor's entire customer lifecycle, not just the call itself.

market: AI voice agents for home services

market_patterns.pattern: Products that land go deep on one specific workflow for one specific trade rather than selling horizontal AI. Referral and word-of-mouth dominate early distribution.
market_patterns.failure_mode: The ones that stall are built for an adjacent trade and stretched to fit, or stay generic.

market_patterns.pattern: For AI voice/SDR products selling to SMBs in legacy sectors, the fastest deployments require no behavioral change from end users. Stickiness comes from data accumulation, not feature lock-in.
market_patterns.failure_mode: Products caught between SMB price sensitivity and enterprise-length sales cycles.

market_patterns.pattern: Field sales and in-person trust-building compress sales cycles to 10-14 days. PE-backed operators are the fastest ICP.
market_patterns.failure_mode: Teams that rely only on digital outbound stall at the trust gap.

round2.email1_body_drafted:
Hey Brendan - Know I've reached out a couple times but wanted to see if now is a better time. I lead our vertical AI investing at Telescope, a $275M Series A fund started by a former Sequoia partner. We lead $5-30M Series A investments in a handful of exceptional companies each year.

I'm a big fan of businesses that embed into the conversations where work actually happens and use that to build a system of record that legacy software can't replicate. Home services is a great example where the most valuable customer data lives in phone calls and inquiry forms that never make it into a CRM. I think the companies that capture those conversations natively end up holding something much more defensible than a feature set, because once a contractor's entire customer history lives in the platform, walking away means losing institutional memory.

I'd love to hear how you guys are thinking of the problem - are you free to chat next week? Would love to talk even if you're not raising - LMK your thoughts.
